note: Authoritative seeded-bug list. PRIVATE. This file must never be given to an agent at run time, pasted into a prompt, or exposed through an API. Agents receive only the bug ids they are allowed to activate. Keep this file out of any context pack, tool output, or review bundle that an agent can read.
activation: Add ?bugs=<id>[,<id>] to any page URL, or set SEEDED_BUGS=all on the server. Active ids are exposed at GET /api/__bugs.

bugs.symptom: Checkout total is too high because tax is counted twice: the tax line is added to a subtotal that already includes tax.
bugs.expected_detection: Checkout spec asserting total equals subtotal plus 8% tax rounded to cents, and the order total matches the cart total.

bugs.symptom: Login accepts an empty password for the demo account and returns a token instead of 401.
bugs.expected_detection: Login spec for invalid credentials, asserting empty password and a wrong password both return 401 and show the login error box.

bugs.symptom: A negative quantity is accepted by the cart API (add or patch) and produces a negative line total and a reduced cart total.
bugs.expected_detection: Cart spec asserting POST /api/cart or PATCH /api/cart/:productId with qty -1 returns 400 and leaves the cart unchanged.

bugs.symptom: The product list returns an intermittent 500 on roughly one request in a few, so the page sometimes renders empty.
bugs.expected_detection: Products spec that calls /api/products three times and asserts every response is 200; the third call returns 500.

bugs.symptom: Add to cart is delayed by a random wait, so the toast and the cart count appear late and sometimes after the test has moved on.
bugs.expected_detection: Add-to-cart spec asserting the toast becomes visible and the cart link updates without relying on a fixed sleep.

bugs.symptom: The checkout button label changes from the expected text to a different label, which breaks locators based on text or accessible name.
bugs.expected_detection: Checkout spec that reaches the button by its expected label; the failure should be triaged as a locator break, then resolved by using data-testid=checkout-button rather than by editing the assertion.

bugs.symptom: Discount code SAVE10 is applied as a flat $10 instead of 10% of the subtotal.
bugs.expected_detection: Checkout spec applying SAVE10 and asserting the discount equals 10% of subtotal, capped at subtotal, with total recomputed.

bugs.symptom: Search becomes case-sensitive, so a lowercase query returns no items when it should match by name.
bugs.expected_detection: Products search spec querying a lowercase and an uppercase form of the same product name and asserting the same result.

bugs.symptom: An out-of-stock product can still be added to the cart and checked out.
bugs.expected_detection: Cart spec asserting add-to-cart is refused or disabled for a product with stock 0, and checkout is blocked while it is in the cart.

bugs.symptom: Order history returns orders that belong to other users, so the logged-in user sees orders they did not place.
bugs.expected_detection: Orders spec with two tokens, asserting each user sees only their own orders and that the order count matches what that user checked out.

bugs.symptom: Setting quantity to 0 removes the item from the cart but leaves the subtotal, tax, and total at their old values.
bugs.expected_detection: Cart spec setting qty to 0 and asserting the API returns 400 with the cart unchanged, per the contract; if the UI accepts 0, assert the item stays and totals do not go stale.

bugs.symptom: Removing an item leaves a stale total: the row disappears but subtotal, tax, and total still include the removed line.
bugs.expected_detection: Cart spec removing one of two items and asserting the new subtotal, tax, and total match the remaining item.

bugs.symptom: Checkout succeeds with an empty cart, returning an order with zero items instead of 400 cart empty.
bugs.expected_detection: Checkout spec starting from an empty cart and asserting 400 with error cart empty, and no order created.

bugs.symptom: A failed login shows a raw server stack trace in the error box instead of the generic error message.
bugs.expected_detection: Login spec for a failed attempt, asserting the error box shows the expected message and contains no stack trace, file path, or internal detail.

bugs.symptom: Money is formatted from floating point without rounding to cents, so a computed total can render with three decimals, such as $21.589.
bugs.expected_detection: Cart and checkout specs asserting every money value is a number with two decimals and renders as $X.XX, including unit price, tax, and total.
